intro: Six articles tagged government, published between 12 April and 12 September 2026, document a period in which SHADOW-EARTH-053 and ShinyHunters were the most-covered threat actors. Government, defense, and law enforcement sectors absorbed the reported activity, with the United States, East Asia, Europe, Florida, and France among the affected regions. The severity mix across the six articles comprises four high-severity items and one medium-severity item. SHADOW-EARTH-053 and ShinyHunters appear as distinct entities in the coverage.
